column4: Pixel-art game sprite in the style of 1990s Build-engine games (Duke Nukem 3D, Redneck Rampage): chunky visible pixels, a limited muted palette, strong simple shading, a single object in the centre, full size, seen from straight above lying flat. Background must be flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere around it, no ground shadow, no floor, no text, no border, no watermark. An old worn dark brown leather bifold wallet lying wide open, seen from straight above: the left half a long open pocket for banknotes with a scuffed leather edge, the right half a coin pouch with its stitched flap turned back and dark inside, cracked leather, pale worn corners, thick pale stitching, nothing in it. Plain, eastern-bloc, 1990s.

Six pieces of 1990s central-European money: in a row along the top four separate banknotes, each a long rectangle of the same size, one dull green, one dull blue, one dull red, one dull purple, fine engraved guilloche patterns, a small oval engraved portrait of an old man rubbed away to a pale smudge, a blank pale oval on the other side where the value goes, soft worn folds and creases, dirty edges; in a row along the bottom two separate coins, one plain dull silver coin with a beaded rim and a blank flat middle, one plain dull brass coin with a beaded rim and a blank flat middle. No numbers, no letters on anything.

The worn top of a village shop counter seen from straight above, filling the whole canvas: a grey-brown speckled 1970s laminate, scratched and dulled, faint ring stains, a pale worn track where money and goods have been slid across it for thirty years, a cigarette burn, a dark chipped metal edge strip along the bottom of the picture. Tired and eerie under a fluorescent tube. The same colours and pixel size as the reference picture.

Three separate small black and white newspaper photographs of a Czech village, each a plain rectangle with hard edges, coarse halftone dots, printed badly on cheap paper, grey and flat: a village pond with bare willows and one small dark figure standing on the far bank; a small baroque chapel with a bare linden tree under a white sky, its door a little open; a row of villagers in winter coats standing in a ploughed field with their backs to the camera, all looking at the same thing that is not in the picture. Unsettling, quiet, nothing happening.
